notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
I've listened to the feedback so far and this update should address most of the small concerns.
[*]Infinite Wave Mode - You can now take on infinite waves of enemies, and see how you place against others with a Steam leaderboard.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31402496/feac2bb58388d773a3275e5e17ac49bf84199842.gif[/img]
[*]UI Redo - The wheel and switches are being removed, as many people had trouble using them.  A window based UI will be replacing them.  Also the inventory is accessible from anywhere, instead of just on the ship.  The settings and general buttons have been combined into a single UI.[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31402496/2ec12c057c9a160b4a6563e0409ce829e4bfaf8e.png[/img]
[*]Compass - There is a consistent facing compass by your feet when you open the menu.  It will also have small comets to direct you to where the goals are, for when you can't see the larger comets in the sky.[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31402496/3460318798028d4dfaf7763492d7e0a7eace7021.png[/img]
[*]Touchpad based movement - one controller will move you based on the touchpad or joystick position, you will still need to teleport between islands.  To enable this movement style toggle it on in the settings.  This movement style is not advised for those who get motion sick easily.
[*]Intro - The tutorial is now a story intro as well.  This will get work over time as the story mode gets more flushed out.
[*]Buddy - The green golem that has been following you around now talks.  I know many of you could find this annoying, so you can also mute him in the settings.
[*]Staffs - The charged up particles now appear in a straight line, allowing for better aim of the fireball.  Also two new specials: Frost Nova damages all nearby enemies, Flamethrower gives a large direction area of damage.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31402496/3ed7577179f076fc5352b4d5a07eb6a362d4d595.gif[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31402496/92711b03cabb7a36a8fefc799a91806c3165b8fc.gif[/img]
